points.en: Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992 is the primary legislation.
points.hi: Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992 is the primary legislation.

points.en: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry is the regulatory authority.
points.hi: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry is the regulatory authority.

points.en: Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) provides the roadmap for export promotion and import management.
points.hi: Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) provides the roadmap for export promotion and import management.

points.en: Tariff Barriers: Customs duties and anti-dumping duties to protect domestic industry.
points.hi: Tariff Barriers: Customs duties and anti-dumping duties to protect domestic industry.

points.en: Non-Tariff Barriers: Quotas, licensing requirements, technical standards (SPS/TBT), and quality control orders.
points.hi: Non-Tariff Barriers: Quotas, licensing requirements, technical standards (SPS/TBT), and quality control orders.

points.en: Prohibited, Restricted, and Free categories for items under ITC(HS) codes.
points.hi: Prohibited, Restricted, and Free categories for items under ITC(HS) codes.

explanation.en: Quotas, Licensing, and Technical standards represent the core non-tariff control mechanisms.
explanation.hi: Quotas, Licensing, and Technical standards represent the core non-tariff control mechanisms.

question.en: Which act governs India's foreign trade?
question.hi: Which act governs India's foreign trade?

answer.en: The Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992.
answer.hi: The Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992.

misconception.en: DGFT is under the Ministry of Finance.
misconception.hi: DGFT is under the Ministry of Finance.

correction.en: DGFT is under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
correction.hi: DGFT is under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

fiveFacts.en: FTP is notified by the Ministry of Commerce.
fiveFacts.hi: FTP is notified by the Ministry of Commerce.

fiveFacts.en: Customs Act, 1962 governs the actual collection of duties.
fiveFacts.hi: Customs Act, 1962 governs the actual collection of duties.

fiveFacts.en: Anti-dumping duties are recommended by the DGTR.
fiveFacts.hi: Anti-dumping duties are recommended by the DGTR.

fiveFacts.en: Import licenses are required for restricted items.
fiveFacts.hi: Import licenses are required for restricted items.

fiveFacts.en: Export promotion schemes include RoDTEP and SEIS.
fiveFacts.hi: Export promotion schemes include RoDTEP and SEIS.
